source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相欲定，静压欲裂
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC34 after EP02 SC33 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where fact and restraint are nearly finished into the next threshold: Keshadu's conclusion is almost irreversibly fixed, Shisilang's fury is close to outright rupture, Tuobaye has almost nothing left to spend, and the white-clothed woman's restraint is poised at the edge of visible break.
title: 真相欲定，静压欲裂

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC33 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC33 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将成，十四郎怒线将断，拓拔野近乎见底，白衣女子的静压已到将破边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推到真正无法回退。科沙度的判断几乎已经固化，十四郎的怒势也快撕裂场面，拓拔野只剩本能硬撑。白衣女子的克制则来到几乎立刻就要翻面的边缘。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将破推进到真正破开的门前，为后续明确出手或揭露做直接引爆。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and restrained until the true source beat forces the visible break; no decorative spectacle before the actual turn.
Keshadu should feel close to irrevocable certainty.
Shisilang remains unstable and close to real rupture.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
